chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Amr ibn Muslim, from Al-Thu'mali, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who is saved among men is few, and among women is fewer and fewer.' It was said, 'And why, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Because they are disbelievers in anger and believers in pleasure.'

key_terms.النَّاجِي: The saved one / The one who is delivered

ai.seo_question: Why are fewer women saved according to the hadith from Abu Ja'far?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to illustrate the spiritual fragility of women, a concept rooted in the Shia understanding of 'kufr al-ghadab' (disbelief in anger) and 'iman al-rida' (faith in contentment). This highlights how intense emotional states can temporarily obscure spiritual awareness, a theme often discussed in Shia tafsir regarding the balance between intellect and emotion in achieving righteousness.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Amro Bin Muslim, from Al Sumaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The salvaged from the men are a few, and from the women are fewer and fewer’. It was said, ‘And why, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Because they are disbelievers while angry, and Believers while pleased’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Khalid from his father from Muhammad ibn Sinan from “Amr ibn Muslim from al-Thumaliy who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘Of men very few find salvation and from women that number is even less and less.’ It was asked, ‘Why is it so O Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause?’ He (the Messenger of Allah) replied, because they are unbelievers in anger (in it they may act like unbelievers) and believers in consent.’”
